headline: Sugar Price: Sugar prices fell sharply at mill gates, so why didn't shops get as cheap? Find out when relief may come | Sugar Price Hike Reasons Ex Mill And Retail Price
summary: Retail sugar prices are up about 38% year on year on low production and festival demand, while mill-gate prices have fallen about 30% after duty-free imports and government monitoring.
why: Sugar is an agricultural commodity whose India prices depend on cane output, import policy and stock levels, affecting food inflation and processors.
